newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close steady on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close steady on profit-taking.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed almost steady amid both buying and selling by retail investors, brokers said.

The Dhaka stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index closed 7.97 points or 0.49 percent down at 1,606.55 on a turnover of 94.03 million taka before the market closed for Moslem Friday weekend. Of 112 issues traded 57 lost, 48 rose and seven flat.
"The market sentiment is good. Most of the scrips are very attractive. But the index shed some points only because of the fall of few blue chips on profit-taking," said one broker.
Singer Bangladesh lost 199 taka to 12,476, Apex Foods gained 99 to 3,144 and Beximco Pharmaceuticals was up 3.34 to 219.75.
